component.name: elasticsearch
component.title: Elasticsearch
component.description: Index, update, get, search and delete documents and indices in Elasticsearch with the Java API Client.
component.label: search,monitoring

connectionTimeout.description: The connect timeout in milliseconds: the longest time that the client waits to establish the connection to a node. Not used when the client option is set.

enableDocumentOnlyMode.description: Whether the body of Update is only the partial document to merge into the document. If false, the body is the request body of the Update API, such as {doc: {...}} or a script. Only JSON text, bytes, a stream, a file or a Map is read this way. The CamelElasticsearchEnableDocumentOnlyMode header replaces this option.

hostAddresses.description: The comma-separated list of the nodes to connect to, each as host:port, for example es1:9200,es2:9200. The port is 9200 if not set, and the scheme is https when enableSSL is set. Required unless the client option is set.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

maxRetryTimeout.description: Deprecated: this option has no effect. It was used by the old low-level REST client and is ignored by the current client.

socketTimeout.description: The socket timeout in milliseconds: the longest time that the client waits for data from a node before the request fails. Not used when the client option is set.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

client.label: advanced
client.description: To use an existing org.elasticsearch.client.RestClient, shared by all the endpoints of the component, instead of a client that each producer creates. The hostAddresses, timeout, authentication, SSL, sniffer and disconnect options are then not used, and the producers do not close the client.

enableSniffer.label: advanced
enableSniffer.description: Whether to start the Sniffer of the Elasticsearch REST client, which reads the nodes of the cluster from its Nodes Info API at an interval and updates the nodes that the client uses. Not used when the client option is set or autowired, as Spring Boot does.

sniffAfterFailureDelay.label: advanced
sniffAfterFailureDelay.description: The delay in milliseconds of the read of the nodes that the Sniffer schedules after a failed request, when enableSniffer is set.

snifferInterval.label: advanced
snifferInterval.description: The interval in milliseconds between two reads of the nodes of the cluster, when enableSniffer is set.

apiKey.label: security
apiKey.description: API key to authenticate with, sent in the Authorization header instead of a user and password. Either the encoded key as Elasticsearch shows it when the key is created, or the id and the key separated by a colon (id:key). The key is only sent to the configured hosts and the nodes found by the sniffer.

certificatePath.label: security
certificatePath.description: The CA certificate, in X.509 format, that the client trusts for HTTPS instead of the default trust store of the JVM. It is loaded from the classpath by default, or with the prefix classpath:, file: or http:. It needs enableSSL, and sslContextParameters takes precedence.

enableSSL.label: security
enableSSL.description: Whether to connect to the nodes of hostAddresses with HTTPS instead of HTTP. The default SSLContext of the JVM is used unless sslContextParameters or certificatePath is set.

password.label: security
password.description: The password for HTTP basic authentication to the nodes, used only together with user. Not used when the client option is set.

sslContextParameters.label: security
sslContextParameters.description: To configure security using SSLContextParameters, which sets the protocols, cipher suites, named groups and signature schemes of the HTTPS connection. It takes precedence over certificatePath, and it needs enableSSL.

useGlobalSslContextParameters.label: security
useGlobalSslContextParameters.description: Whether to use the global SSLContextParameters of the CamelContext for an endpoint that has no sslContextParameters.

user.label: security
user.description: The user name for HTTP basic authentication to the nodes, used only together with password. It cannot be combined with apiKey. Not used when the client option is set.

CamelElasticsearchOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs. It replaces the operation option. A request of the Elasticsearch Java API Client in the body sets the operation by its type and replaces both.

CamelElasticsearchIndexId.description: The id of the document for Index and Update. If it is not set for Index, Elasticsearch generates the id.

CamelElasticsearchIndexName.description: The name of the index that the operation acts on. It replaces the indexName option.

CamelElasticsearchDocumentClass.description: The class to which the documents in the responses of GetById, MultiGet, Search and MultiSearch are deserialized. It replaces the documentClass option.

CamelElasticsearchWaitForActiveShards.description: The number of active shard copies that Index and Update wait for before they write. It replaces the waitForActiveShards option.

CamelElasticsearchScrollKeepAliveMs.description: The time in milliseconds that Elasticsearch keeps the search context of a scroll alive between two scroll requests. It replaces the scrollKeepAliveMs option.

CamelElasticsearchUseScroll.description: Whether Search reads all the hits with the scroll API. It replaces the useScroll option.

CamelElasticsearchSize.description: The maximum number of hits that Search returns when the body is JSON text or a Map. It replaces the size option.

CamelElasticsearchFrom.description: The offset of the first hit that Search returns when the body is JSON text or a Map. It replaces the from option.

CamelElasticsearchEnableDocumentOnlyMode.description: Whether the body of Update is only the partial document to merge into the document. It replaces the enableDocumentOnlyMode option.

producerIn.description: By the operation, set by the operation option or the CamelElasticsearchOperation header, or by the request of the Elasticsearch client in the body. Index and Update take the document as JSON text, bytes, a stream or a file of it, or a Map or a POJO (written as JSON); text that is not JSON, a List or no body fail. Update expects the Update API form, {"doc": {...}}, unless enableDocumentOnlyMode is set. GetById and Delete take the id as text, Bulk and MultiGet a List of documents or ids, Search the search request as JSON text or a Map, with its query, size, sort, aggregations and the rest (an object with a single member other than query is the query alone), and DeleteIndex the name of the index as text, used when neither the CamelElasticsearchIndexName header nor indexName is set. Each also takes its request of the Elasticsearch client, or the builder of it, which is sent as it is; MultiSearch takes only those. Exists and Ping do not use the body

producerOut.description: The id of the document as text for Index and Update. GetById gives the GetResponse of the Elasticsearch client (found() is false for no document), Search the HitsMetadata of the hits, or with useScroll an ElasticsearchScrollRequestIterator of the hits to close after use; the source of a hit is a Jackson ObjectNode unless documentClass is set. MultiGet, MultiSearch and Bulk give a List of the response item of each document or search, Delete the Result enum (Deleted or NotFound), and DeleteIndex, Exists and Ping a Boolean

clusterName.description: The name of the Elasticsearch cluster. The producer uses it only in its log messages: the hostAddresses option or the client option of the component sets the nodes to connect to.

connectionTimeout.description: The connect timeout in milliseconds: the longest time that the client waits to establish the connection to a node. Not used when the client option of the component is set.

disconnect.description: Whether the producer creates the client for each exchange and closes it when the exchange is done, or with useScroll when the scroll iterator is closed, instead of keeping one client from its start to its stop. Not used when the client option of the component is set.

enableDocumentOnlyMode.description: Whether the body of Update is only the partial document to merge into the document. If false, the body is the request body of the Update API, such as {doc: {...}} or a script. Only JSON text, bytes, a stream, a file or a Map is read this way. The CamelElasticsearchEnableDocumentOnlyMode header replaces this option.

from.description: The offset of the first hit that Search returns when the body is JSON text or a Map. It replaces the from of the body, and the CamelElasticsearchFrom header replaces this option.

hostAddresses.description: The comma-separated list of the nodes to connect to, each as host:port, for example es1:9200,es2:9200. The port is 9200 if not set, and the scheme is https when enableSSL is set. Required unless the client option of the component is set.

indexName.description: The name of the index that the operation acts on. Bulk uses it as the default index of its operations, and DeleteIndex deletes this index instead of the one named by the body. The CamelElasticsearchIndexName header replaces this option, and a request of the Elasticsearch Java API Client in the body keeps its own index.

maxRetryTimeout.description: Deprecated: this option has no effect. It was used by the old low-level REST client and is ignored by the current client.

operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelElasticsearchOperation header replaces this option. A request of the Elasticsearch Java API Client in the body, such as an IndexRequest or a SearchRequest, sets the operation by its type and replaces both.

scrollKeepAliveMs.description: The time in milliseconds that Elasticsearch keeps the search context of a scroll alive between two scroll requests, when useScroll is set. The CamelElasticsearchScrollKeepAliveMs header replaces this option.

size.description: The maximum number of hits that Search returns when the body is JSON text or a Map. It replaces the size of the body, and the CamelElasticsearchSize header replaces this option.

socketTimeout.description: The socket timeout in milliseconds: the longest time that the client waits for data from a node before the request fails. Not used when the client option of the component is set.

useScroll.description: Whether Search reads all the hits with the scroll API. The body is then an ElasticsearchScrollRequestIterator of the hits, which sends the scroll requests while it is read and is to be closed after use. The CamelElasticsearchUseScroll header replaces this option.

waitForActiveShards.description: The number of active shard copies that Index and Update wait for before they write. The default of 1 waits only for the primary shard. The CamelElasticsearchWaitForActiveShards header replaces this option.

documentClass.description: The class to which the documents in the responses of GetById, MultiGet, Search and MultiSearch are deserialized. The default is the Jackson ObjectNode. The CamelElasticsearchDocumentClass header replaces this option.

sniffAfterFailureDelay.label: advanced
sniffAfterFailureDelay.description: The delay in milliseconds of the read of the nodes that the Sniffer schedules after a failed request, when enableSniffer is set.

snifferInterval.label: advanced
snifferInterval.description: The interval in milliseconds between two reads of the nodes of the cluster, when enableSniffer is set.

It is loaded from the classpath by default, or with the prefix classpath:, file: or http:. It needs enableSSL, and sslContextParameters takes precedence.
